_comment: TMB TECH - SITE SETTINGS. This is the ONE place for your name, contact details, links and site address.
Edit a value here, save, push. Every page reads this file, so nothing is hard-coded in the HTML or JS.
JSON has no real comments, so any key that starts with an underscore (like this _comment) is a note for you. The site ignores those keys.

1. Contact details, names and links inside the pages are written as tokens like {{company.contact.email}}. js/settings.js swaps them for the values below when the page opens. Change the value here and every page updates. No other step is needed.

2. A few things must exist as plain HTML for Google, WhatsApp and LinkedIn, because those bots do not run JavaScript: the page title, description, share-preview tags, sitemap.xml, robots.txt and 404.html. They are generated from this same file. After you change the site address, company name or a page title/description, run:  python tools/render.py   then commit and push.
3. Contact details (email, phone, LinkedIn, GitHub, founder) do NOT need step 2. Just edit and push.
CAREFUL: keep the JSON valid (double quotes, commas between items, no comma after the last item). If it is broken, contact details will not show. Check with:  python tools/render.py --check

TOKENS you can use inside the pages: {{company.name}}  {{company.contact.email}}  {{company.contact.phone}}  {{company.contact.phone|digits}} (digits only, for tel: links)  {{year}}  {{site.baseUrl}}  {{products.gasone.url}}  and any other path in this file.

company._comment: Who you are. Shown in headers, footers, contact sections, privacy policies and the share previews.
company.name: TMB Tech
company.description: {{company.name}} builds business applications, ERP systems, mobile apps, web applications and custom software solutions.
company._description: Any text in this file can use tokens such as {{company.name}}; they are filled in when the pages load.
company._copyrightStartYear: The footer shows this year, or a range like 2026-2028 once the current year moves past it.

contact._comment: The email is also where every contact form sends its message (it opens the visitor's email app addressed to this address).
contact._phone: Write the phone the way you want it shown. tel: links are made from it automatically (spaces removed).

social._comment: url = where the link goes. handle and display = the text shown next to it.

site._comment: Where the site lives. Used for canonical links, share previews, the sitemap and links between the company site and the product sites.
site._baseUrl: Must end with a slash. If you move to your own domain, change this and run  python tools/render.py

stores._comment: App store links. Each product's own package id and 'live' switch are in the products section below.

_comment: Free-trial wording shown on the sites, in one place. Whether a product offers a trial is set per product (products.<name>.trial.available).
The 'Request free trial' buttons scroll to the contact form and fill in that product's trial message, and the email arrives with the subject 'intent'.

_comment: One entry per product. 'path' is the folder on this site. If a product moves to its OWN domain later, put the full address in 'url' (for example https://gasone.in/) and every link to it, in every page, follows automatically.
Leave 'url' empty while the product is served from this site.
